feature.label: Java Scoped Variables Core (required)
feature.description: This plug-in adds project scoped variables to the Eclipse Java preferences. These variables can be used in Java templates to add the name of the team that is responsible for the project or the year the project was started. It also allows you to define your own project scoped variables. The plug-in was inspired by waffel's Weblog, 'Use your own variable in eclipse code templates' at https://thomaswabner.wordpress.com/2009/08/21/use-your-own-variable-in-eclipse-code-templates/.
